Applies to S6-S8 and S12. Next seat W4-G5.

resume.note: S4 RECORDED HALT, merged as PR #508 (e46fb15) at merge-base 5a4e6ff — no production change, and that is the stage outcome, not a failure. Re-measured with tests/structure.py's own seam block: cut_fetch 115 = xattr 77 + xmeth 38 over 28 methods owning 15 attrs; the survey's producer-dominance prior is confirmed independently. DECOMPOSITION FOR S12: 60 refs from OTHER seams to fetch-owned attrs, 32 inbound call edges, 17 refs inside fetch to attrs it does not own, 6 outbound edges — so 92 of 115 (80%) is other seams reaching in and is not a function of fetch's own bodies. Owned attrs by outside reads: _open_meteo 12, _prices 12, _price_model 7, _last_simulation 6, _simulation_cache 5, _weather_forecast 4, _price_days_seen 3, _price_qdays_seen 3, _price_known_steps 2, then _solar_radiation_forecast, _weather_outage_cycles, _weather_stale_since, _tibber_outage_cycles, _tibber_reauth_started, _price_tile_cursor at 1 each. Condition 2. SEQUENCED TO S12 (W4-G13), NOT FORBIDDEN: the judge's #193 measurement is that no component of size>1 detaches at any k, so moving fetch out now relocates the cut across a module boundary instead of removing it. MEASURED AND DECLINED: moving the two ctx-only leaf adapters _wear_price and _solar_forecast_source to coordinator.py module level over a plain config dict measures cut_fetch 115->111, cut_views 85->83, coordinator_loc 10164->10143, coordinator_methods 251->249, internal_call_edges 367->362, with nothing rising. Refused: the whole -4 is inbound-call-edge deletion that leaves the seam 79% producer-bound, paid for by pushing _config reads into five call sites across three seams and rewriting three tests/features.py assertions, which S12 would then unwind. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE W4-A SURVEY, neither changing its verdict: fetch has no zero-state method, but _wear_price, _solar_forecast_source and _price_tile_specs reference self ONLY through getattr(self, "_ctx", self), which structure.py counts as zero (_get_current_price is NOT zero-state — its two apparent self refs are self-method calls to _current_spot_price and _current_grid_fee, so it cannot move); and the 32 inbound call edges are not wholly unreachable — 4 fall out if those adapters leave the class. CORRECTED 2026-09-06 (#512, re-measured directly against tests/structure.py's own seam_metrics at head b6a21f1, not carried forward from the survey): cut_fetch is 132, not 115 -- xattr 60 (other seams reading fetch-owned attrs, UNCHANGED) + 34 (fetch's own reads of attrs it does not own, up from 17) = 94; xmeth unchanged at 32 inbound + 6 outbound = 38. The whole +17 is fetch reading MORE of other seams' state through the getattr(self, "_ctx", self) idiom this fix now sees, not other seams reading more of fetch's. The other-seams-reaching-in share stays 92 in absolute count but is now 92 of 132 (70%, not 80%); HANDOVER.md's Owed note guessed the addressable share holds at 23 of 132 -- measured, it is 40 of 132 (17 inside-non-owned -> 34, outbound unchanged at 6), so that note is itself stale and this entry supersedes it. The halt's actual basis is untouched by the recount: cut_fetch rising rather than falling means fetch is more, not less, entangled with the rest of the class than S4 recorded, and the judge's #193 'no component of size>1 detaches at any k' finding is a structural measurement this fix does not touch. Next seat W4-G6.
